summary: Tested new GML (Gold Metal Loan) facility type end-to-end: backend API + full UI wizard flow, WCDL working page integration, CC opening-balance guidance note regression, Dashboard 'AK' greeting, and navigation sanity of Dashboard/Reconciliation/Reports. All 6 backend pytest cases passed and all UI assertions passed. DB restored to 0 facilities after cleanup.

issues: Dev-mode React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by Emergent's live-instrumentation wrapper around the inline JSX expression `{f.type === 'GML' ? ' (GML)' : ''}` inside <option>. Runtime UI still renders correctly (dropdown shows 'TEST_UI_GML · TEST UI Gold Loan (GML)'). This is a dev-only warning and not a production bug, but concatenating the string outside JSX (e.g. `{`${f.bank} · ${f.name}${f.type==='GML'?' (GML)':''}`}`) would silence it.

critical_code_review_comments: Consider concatenating the GML suffix as a single JS string expression inside <option> children instead of two adjacent JSX expressions to avoid the dev-tool <span>-in-<option> hydration warning (WCDLWorking.jsx lines 28 and 89).
server.py mixes CORS wildcard with allow_credentials=True, which browsers reject. Preview URL works because credentials aren't sent here, but this is an existing issue, not GML-related.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 GML + 1 CC facility for UI testing; both deleted via API at the end. GET /api/facilities returns [] confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GML feature works end-to-end. Backend: /api/facilities accepts type=GML, /api/wcdl-working returns GML rows, /api/wcdl-loans accepts GML facility and rejects CC. Frontend: 3-option Type segmented control (CC/WCDL/GML) in wizard step 1, GML default maturity=90 days, .tag.gml badge in Facility Master, WCDL Working page shows GML in dropdown with '(GML)' suffix, loan input placeholder switches to GML-*, header title says 'WCDL & gold loan working'. CC first-transaction opening-balance note ([data-testid=opening-balance-note]) renders correctly on brand-new CC facility. Dashboard greeting shows 'AK'. DB confirmed empty post-test.
